name: Orbit.duplicate
statement: X) (w : α × Bool) : {(mk [w])⁻¹ • y | y ∈ MulAction.orbit (startsWith w) x} = (⋃ v ∈ {z : α × Bool | z ≠ (w.1, !w.2)}, MulAction.orbit (startsWith v) x) ∪ {x}

have_tree.name: h
have_tree.type: (⟨g, hg⟩ : startsWith w) = ⟨mk g.toWord, by simp [g.mk_toWord, hg]⟩

children.name: ha
children.body: by simpa [← hl, startsWith] using hg
